# Karina Orocio Cruz — Abogada Postulante en Oaxaca

> Lic. Karina Orocio Cruz is a senior practicing private law attorney in Oaxaca, Mexico. Specializing in Family Law (Divorce, Child Support, Custody), Civil Law, Commercial Litigation, Real Estate Title Clearing (Usucapión), and Municipal Legal Defense.

## Primary Legal Practice Areas

- **Derecho Familiar / Family Law**: Uncontested & contested divorce (Divorcio Incausado), child support calculation & garnishment (Pensión Alimenticia), child custody (Guarda y Custodia), and adoption.
- **Bienes y Propiedades / Real Estate & Property**: Adverse possession lawsuits (Juicio de Usucapión), property title regularization, boundary disputes, and real estate legal due diligence in Oaxaca City, Puerto Escondido, Huatulco, and Tuxtepec.
- **Derecho Civil y Mercantil / Civil & Commercial Law**: Contract drafting, breach of contract litigation, debt recovery, and probate/estate administration (Juicio Sucesorio Intestamentario y Testamentario).
- **Derecho Municipal y Administrativo / Municipal Law**: Local government permits, municipal compliance, and administrative defense in Oaxaca.
